description.p: QR Code Forge is a modern desktop QR code generator. Pick a content type, style the code, and export it — all offline, no telemetry.

ul.li: QR codes with styled dots (square, rounded, dots, classy) and solid or gradient colors
Logo, photo, or emoji in the middle of the code (error correction auto-raised)
Structured payloads: WiFi join, vCard contact, Email, SMS, phone, geo location, WhatsApp
Export as PNG, JPG, or SVG at up to 4096 px, or copy straight to the clipboard
History of recent codes, dark and light themes, i18n-ready string table
